source.note: v0.3 remains untouched; this contract reinterprets its PNGs as paper mechanisms.

diagnosis.primaryFailure: Every final city mesh in v0.3 resolves to an XY billboard facing the camera; order changes, but perspective and occlusion do not produce a physically legible paper volume.
diagnosis.secondaryFailure: The grouped PNGs are not single manufacturable silhouettes. Their declared bottom hinge often touches alpha only across a small fraction of the width, so buildings and people appear to float from an invisible sheet.
doNotRepeat: Do not put every cutout at rotation.x=0 facing camera.
Do not hinge a disconnected people PNG as one transparent panel.
Do not turn artwork with baked top-down perspective into a 90-degree facade.
Do not use scale, opacity or UV reveal to simulate paper rising.

cameraTarget.rule: The page is XZ and height is Y. No final card may be parallel to the camera sensor.

mechanicalRules: Every elevated texture needs visible geometry connecting it to a hinge, slot, tab or box-fold support.
A source with baked roofs, floor or street perspective stays on a deck or inclined relief plane.
A source that reads as an elevation may become a vertical V-fold card.
Tabs and base rails use page paper color and are hidden behind a lower row, but must cast contact shadows.
All mechanisms are driven by book open angle. Timing offsets change slack/occlusion, not scale or opacity.
Minimum separation between nominally adjacent planes is 4 mm; coincident layers are forbidden.

lightingAndContact.key: single warm desk-lamp direction inherited from approved composite
required: 2-4 mm contact shadow under every hinge rail and standee foot
soft row-to-row cast shadows that move during opening
ambient occlusion only at paper intersections
paper thickness edge 0.35-0.6 mm on silhouette cards
forbidden: global drop shadow copied from final PSD

implementationGates: Clay render must read as five depth zones before textures are enabled.
Side-profile render must show decks, tabs and cards touching paper without floating.
Normal render must preserve the approved composite hierarchy without returning to coplanar billboards.
No whole-group people plane may exist in the scene graph.
Final endpoint must show at least 4 mm world-space separation between rear, mid and front card families.
